name: prof-openloop-ramp180-03
description: Ratchet discriminator, take 3: capture the rotor with 0.5 A stepped openloop ramp to 180 rad/s el, then drop to the prof-hold hold current (0.3 A) for ~3.5 s, still pure OpenLoop (no probes, no startup machinery). If the parallel observer ratchets during the 0.3 A hold -> low-current continuous mechanism (dead-time zero-crossing residual class); if it stays locked at ~180 -> the startup machinery (probes / punch transient) is the pump.
